tenderSchedule.title: Appointment of service providers for providing Pre-Recruitment residential training to MINORITIES candidates who wish to join AS POLICE SUB INSPECTOR OR POLICE CONSTABLE AT KARNATAKA STATE POLICE (FOR MEN AND WOMEN) - IN 4 DIFFERENT ZONES OF KARNATAKA
tenderSchedule.description: Directorate of Minorities, Minority Welfare Department(MWD) is inviting Short Term e-Tender from competent organizations across the state for imparting coaching to Minorities Community candidates of Karnataka State to provide residential pre recruitment training who wish to join as AS POLICE SUB INSPECTOR OR POLICE CONSTABLE AT KARNATAKA STATE POLICE (FOR MEN and WOMEN) - IN 4 DIFFERENT ZONES OF KARNATAKA under two cover system (Technical Bid and Financial Bid) from service providers who have adequate resources and experience

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions stipulated in the tender document shall be applicable and binding on the bidder.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The candidates who have undergone (full time - complete course) training from the bidding coaching institute must be selected to the Dept. for Karnataka State Police Services during the last 3 notifications/Years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish all the below documentary proof and details as per the format enclosed at Annexure 1 (should be in affidavit with notary)
Others -- The result sheet of Students who have secured appointment in various posts of KSP Services Exams.
Others -- Admission details of the students studied in respective coaching institute, such as fee paid receipt/ institute id card

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have trained students through offline mode (full time complete course) for PC/PSI or Equivalent examinations during the last 3 years. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Details of the students as per the format enclosed at Annexure 3 (should be in affidavit with notary)
Others -- Payment receipts/Institute ID Cards of the students to the institutes
Work Done Certificate
Satisfactory Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have an experience in KSPC civil services pre-examinations training courses in the offline from the last 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration containing list of year wise no. of trained candidates
Others -- registration copies if any or related document to prove the offline existence of the institute from past 3 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have minimum 20 full time faculties with a minimum of 5 years of teaching experience in KSP Civil Services examinations

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid ESI certificate
Valid EPF Certificate
Others -- list of faculty members along with Self declaration containing faculties name, address & qualification also with certificate of experience
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members as per Annexure - 4
Others -- PF/PT/TDS/ESI & Offer letter of the faculty also to be uploaded under e- procurement portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institution should have 8 full time trainers of DEFENSE/PARA MILITARY OFFICERS/POLICE DEPARTMENT ON PAYROLL for Physical Training with a minimum of 5+ years of teaching experience in Karnataka State Police or Allied Civil Services examinations. The Bidder should have at least Two Defense/ Para Military officer/Police Dept. in its payroll in each zone.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- list of trainers along with Self declaration containing faculties name, address & qualification also with certificate of experience
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of training members as per Annexure - 4
Others -- Identity Card of the Staffs
Others -- PF/PT/TDS/ESI & Offer letter of the trainers also to be uploaded under e- procurement portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Coaching institutions must have own set of study materials

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- One set of own study material should be provided before the last date of the submission of the tender and soft copies of the same shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a gated/fenced training center (owned or leased or rented) - for class room coaching, library, medical inspection room with beds, CCTV surveillance, accommodation. - Hygienic kitchen and mess with FSSAI approved vendor and kitchen. physical training should be within the same campus.with minimum 3 acres of ground having for, running track and physical training equipments like Zig Zag, high jump, long jump, 8 feet wall etc.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Submit the following building/location documents in case of rented premises
Others -- proof of ownership or Valid lease/rental agreement
Others -- Geo-location (Google Maps link or coordinates) GPS Photographs of premises (Exterior & Interior)
Others -- FSSAI Certificate and also Details of classrooms and seating capacity
Others -- Availability of essential utilities (electricity, water, internet, washrooms)
Others -- details of a rented building situated at the divisional or district headquarters of the Bengaluru, Belagavi, Mysuru, or Kalaburagi divisions
Others -- All accommodation and associated training facilities shall be located within a 500-meter radius of the designated training/classroom premises

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All the documents sought in the tender document should be uploaded
any other registered document & GST Reg. Certificate
Audited reports, Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Accounts, Turnover certificate certified by CA & ITR filed for the last three years.
Owned - Ownership documents to be enclosed
The bidder shall furnish complete details of the Registered Office address Lease or rented agreement should be previous 3 years
Valid Registration Certificate issued by the competent Government authority under the relevant Act

itemList.itemName: The Training Institution shall quote the course fee per candidate for providing pre-recruitment residential training to minority candidates aspiring to join the Karnataka State Police as Police Sub-Inspectors or Police Constables (Men & Women) at four centres across Karnataka. The fee shall include physical and written test coaching, boarding and lodging, study materials, tracksuits, shoes, group insurance and all applicable taxes. TDS shall be deducted as per applicable rules.
